About the Role:
 
 
 
• As a Legal Assistant, you will contribute to the smooth operation of the organization and act as the backup for the CEO's assistant. Your tasks will include:

Profile – What do we expect from you?
 

 
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 27.000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Job description

Are you an experienced Sales professional who thrives on engaging with the business profiles of clients, C-Level, not just IT? Do you have the drive to not only expand existing customers but also focus on business development and acquiring new logos? Then we are looking for you!

As a Senior Account Manager you will primarily focus on the Industry sector, operating as a true Trusted Advisor for your customers. You will listen to their needs, analyze them, and co-create customized and innovative solutions. Your strength lies in your technology-independent approach. Thanks to our leading technology stacks, you will be able to offer the most specialized solutions. You will also leverage your extensive network to efficiently engage resources.

In this role, you will have a clear purpose: to further grow your customer and prospect portfolio with our solutions and build stable long-term relationships, becoming their partner.

Your role will focus on business development, where you actively identify opportunities, convert leads into long-term collaborations, and create added value for both your customers and the company.

You will be responsible for

 
• Proactively identify and chase new business opportunities within your customer portfolio and prospects.
 
• Build and cultivate strong relationships with prospects and existing customers to foster loyalty and trust.
 
• Keenly follow up on your customers' businesses, understand the trends that impact them, and stay aware of the competitive landscape.
 
• Stay ahead of the curve with the latest technological trends and possibilities, translating these into relevant and inspiring solutions for your customers.

Additional information

Discover your future with inetum belgium

 
• Make a Difference with a Meaningful Career: step into a role where your work truly matters. At Inetum Belgium, you'll have the chance to impact lives and drive meaningful change every day.
 
• Grow and Evolve Professionally: embrace a culture of continuous learning and development. We offer a range of training opportunities designed to help you expand your skills and advance your career.
 
• Unlock Relevant Career Opportunities: pursue the career path you've always dreamed of with tailored opportunities and the IT expertise you need to succeed.
 
• Achieve Work-Life Balance: we value your well-being. Enjoy flexible working hours, the convenience of satellite offices, the comfort of home working, and an informal, no-nonsense environment.
 
• Enjoy...
...

• You thrive on selling solutions & services.

• You are passionate about following the latest trends and translating them into relevant and inspiring solutions for your customers and prospects.

• You use all your Sales and networking skills to get top-of-mind at your customers and target audience.

• You have strong communication and presentation skills.

• You ensure predictability and accuracy in pipeline management.

• You are a team player and orchestrator, able to work closely with our Business Units to support and deliver services by onboarding and engaging them on due time.

• You are open to work in an international environment, even if your Sales area will be Belgium.

• You are fluent in Dutch and English, with base in French being a plus.

• Having an existing network in the Private Sector (Industry) is considered a significant plus.

jobs.description:
Residence Inn by Marriott is an extended stay brand whereby our guests stay for longer periods of time. It is up to us to make them feel at home with our family of associates! All rooms are suites with more living and working space, than you would find in an any other hotel room, including a fully equipped kitchen in every suite! Our guests, The Maximisers, want to maximize their stay and we are here to help them do that, by offering grocery services, complimentary daily breakfast and of course all the places to be in Brussels!
 

Vertiq Hospitality Partners, formerly known as Cycas hospitality, is a leading European hospitality investment and management company, operating a diverse portfolio of hotels and serviced apartments accross eight countries.
 

Our vision is to be the trusted operating partner in European hospitality invevstments and every member of our team must play their part in delivering exceptional service to our guests, our owners, and our colleagues in order to achieve this. With a real focus on performance, people, quality, profit, and communities, team members transform hotels.
 

Your role:
 
 

• Your role will be to ensure the cleaning and tidiness of the rooms and common areas of the hotel, 

• You will check the proper functioning of the equipment and report any anomaly to the General Manager, 

• You will respect the safety and hygiene standards, 

• You will respect the procedures and standards of the hotel, 

• You will take care of the well-being of the customers.  

Our job isn't over until we get a smile!

What we ask of you:
 
 

• 1 year of experience in similar role 

• Allowed to work in the EU 

• Bilingual in the following languages: English/ French and/or Dutch 

• Critical thinker and problem-solving skills 

• Team player 

• Great interpersonal and communication skills 

• Customer-oriented mindset 

• Willing to work on a flexible/standby basis (Interim or Flexi-job)

jobs.occupation: Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer | Pharma | Beerse
jobs.description:
As a Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer, you are responsible for preparing, maintaining and executing qualification documentation for GMP-critical equipment, utilities and systems. You ensure that all documentation complies with applicable GMP requirements and internal quality standards. You work closely with C&Q Leads, Subject Matter Experts and project teams to support qualification projects from initiation through completion. Besides document preparation, you also participate in qualification testing and follow-up activities. Your work plays an important role in ensuring that systems remain in a validated and compliant state.
Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Writing qualification documentation including URS, SRS, IA, DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ, QSR and Validation Master Plans
 
• Executing and documenting qualification tests for equipment, utilities and systems
 
• Assessing the impact of changes, deviations and discrepancies on qualification activities
 
• Coordinating document reviews, approval flows and signature processes
 
• Following up punch list items and qualification actions until closure
 
• Supporting internal and external audits and inspections
 
• Managing document archiving in accordance with GMP and GDP requirements

You are structured, quality-minded and eager to learn. You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and enjoy working in a team-oriented GMP environment. At the same time, you are capable of independently managing documentation and qualification activities.

What you bring

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or technical field such as Industrial Engineering, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
 
• Strong interest in the pharmaceutical industry and GMP-regulated environments
 
• Excellent technical writing and documentation skills
 
• Experience with engineering systems, utilities or manufacturing equipment is an asset
 
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

As a Logistics Administrative Officer, you will support the cross-dock department, where incoming shipments are received, processed and sorted according to their final destination. You play a crucial role in ensuring smooth administrative processing and accurate shipment follow-up.

 
• Open and manage operational files in internal systems from start to finish.
 
• Prepare and process transport-related documentation, including customs and sea freight documents.
 
• Handle invoicing activities accurately and on time.
 
• Ensure timely data entry and follow-up of shipments throughout the transport process.
 
• Process both incoming and outgoing orders efficiently.
 
• Communicate proactively with customers and provide updates regarding their shipments.

We are looking for a motivated professional who enjoys working in a dynamic logistics environment and has a hands-on approach.

 
• You have completed a degree or training in Logistics. Experience within freight forwarding is an advantage.
 
• You are administratively strong and comfortable working with computer systems and digital tools.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and are proactive in identifying and solving issues.
 
• You can work independently while also being a strong team player.
 
• You are communicative, stress-resistant, accurate, proactive, autonomous and result-oriented.
 
• Knowledge of logistics documentation and formalities such as CMR, Packing List, T1 and EX-A is a strong asset.
 
• You have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
 
• You are available for a temporary assignment through an interim contract and can start quickly.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Are you detail-oriented and passionate about data, pricing, and ocean freight? 
 

As a Rate Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient pricing processes that power our global operations.
 

You’ll manage customer contracts, tariffs, and costing data across our systems, enabling seamless auto-rating and auto-costing and supporting our journey toward full digitalization.
 

Working closely with commercial, operational, and system teams, you will help deliver tailored pricing solutions that meet customer requirements while supporting ongoing digitalization and process improvement initiatives. This position is essential in maintaining data integrity and optimizing the performance of our global rating platforms.

 
• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset
 
• Experience in Ocean Freight pricing or operations (minimum 2 years)
 
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
 
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365
 
• Fluent English and Dutch

jobs.occupation: Data Functional Analyst – SQL Server & Power BI
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead discussions with business subject matter experts to identify and understand data-related needs and business processes.
• Translate business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications for data flows and solutions.
• Design and validate conceptual and logical data models in close collaboration with data architects.
• Develop functional designs for business intelligence developments in alignment with data governance and technical leads.
• Liaise with data protection officers to ensure all solutions comply with GDPR and security standards.
• Coordinate the testing of data products and facilitate user training to encourage adoption.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of experience in data functional analysis and data warehouse modelling using the Kimball approach.
• You possess 3+ years of experience with the Microsoft on-premise stack, specifically SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, and Power BI.
• You have a proven track record in analyzing and designing complex operational and analytics data flows.
• You're able to demonstrate strong data literacy and a conceptual understanding of business processes.
• You bring a proactive, can-do attitude with a strong sense of ownership and autonomy.
• You possess excellent problem-solving skills and a pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset.
• You have professional communication and presentation skills.
• You are fluent in French and Dutch with active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Prior experience working as a data engineer.
• Experience with Azure Databricks.

Responsibilities

• Model business processes and guide stakeholders through the redesign of operational workflows.
• Identify business needs and translate them into structured requirements, such as epics and user stories.
• Bridge the gap between business users and IT partners by challenging requirements and validating functional analyses.
• Harmonize business processes across different departments and international sister organizations.
• Oversee the testing and validation of new software releases post-implementation.
• Support change management by developing training materials and conducting sessions for end-users.

Requirements

• You have a Master’s degree in a technical or economic field or equivalent through experience.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in business analysis, requirement elicitation, and process modeling.
• You possess advanced knowledge of BPMN and UML.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and the ability to challenge stakeholders to reach a consensus.
• You're proficient in planning and organizational management within complex project environments.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) or a willingness to learn.
• Knowledge of tools such as Enterprise Architect, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
• Professional background in the electricity sector or industrial asset maintenance.

Responsibilities

• Assess the quality of documentation and implementation evidence provided by internal domains based on security guidance.
• Validate that provided evidence supports self-evaluation scores and is not based on assumptions.
• Provide structured feedback and concrete improvement points to domain owners.
• Build comprehensive audit dossiers and evidence registers for external verification.
• Interpret technical evidence including configuration exports, log files, tickets, and scan reports.
• Support the organization in achieving and maintaining required security maturity levels.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in information security, compliance, or IT audit.
• You possess deep knowledge of security frameworks such as CyFun, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF.
• You bring experience in a second-line security role focusing on validation and oversight.
• You're able to analyze technical data like logs, vulnerability scans, and system configurations.
• You are native in Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with CyFun implementations specifically for essential organizations.
• Knowledge of English.

Are you a Salesforce professional looking to take the next step in your career within an international environment? Join a growing business services organization where technology plays a key role in supporting business transformation across multiple countries.

As a Salesforce Consultant, you will be responsible for optimizing and enhancing the Salesforce ecosystem while working closely with business stakeholders and international teams. You will translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions and contribute to the continuous improvement of business processes.

• Gather and analyze business requirements from various stakeholders.
• Configure and optimize Salesforce solutions across different business domains.
• Participate in projects related to process automation, integrations, and system enhancements.
• Provide functional expertise and support to end users.
• Collaborate with international teams and external partners.
• Contribute to best practices, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Profile

• 3 to 9 years of experience working with Salesforce.
• Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration and business processes.
• Experience interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch and comfortable communicating in English.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.
• Salesforce certifications are considered a plus.
